items.item_text: Registered Nurse (RN) license issued by the state of California.
Specialty certification in related nursing field.
Clinical Nurse Specialist (CNS) license issued by the state of California or licensure / certification in another advanced nurse practice discipline. Required to be hired in CNS role
BLS/CPR certification at time of hire with commitment to get BART within six (6) months of hire date.
Must be able to work various hours and locations based on business needs
Employment is subject to a criminal background check and pre-employment physical
Selected candidate may be hired to the CNS or CNE role depending on experience and credentials.
A Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) is required for the Clinical Nurse Educator (CNE) role.
A Master’s Degree in Nursing (MSN) is required for the Clinical Nurse Specialist (CNS) role.
Seven (7+) or more years of recent and relevant clinical experience.
Five (5+) or more years of recent and relevant educator experience
Experience working with external groups to address health disparities and promote equitable access to healthcare services.
Experience in academic medical center.
Experience with professional presentations and publication.

UC San Diego Health is proud to be a four-time Magnet-designated organization and has now earned Magnet with Distinction from the American Nurses Credentialing Center (ANCC). Magnet is the gold standard for nursing excellence, achieved by only about 10% of hospitals worldwide. Magnet with Distinction is awarded to the highest-performing Magnet organizations, with only a select few earning this prestigious honor. This recognition reflects our commitment to transformational leadership, professional nursing excellence, innovation, exceptional patient outcomes, and an empowering practice environment where nurses thrive.

As an organization or systemwide recognized expert in one or more specialty areas, applies comprehensive knowledge of professional concepts and industry practices to lead projects of large size and scope that have critical impact. Collaborates with nursing management in developing new strategies, policies, and programs and implementing them within nursing clinical practice areas.

Serves as a medical center wide or systemwide clinical practice expert on current best practices in management of the cardiovascular patient, including critical care, interventional procedures, progressive care, assist devices, and transplant.

Serves as an expert resource across multiple nursing units, to assist multidisciplinary teams with the most complex and difficult cases. Collaborates on programs, processes, and education resources for all levels of patient acuity and complexity. Leads interdisciplinary teams in developing and implementing new evidence-based procedures, protocols, guidelines, policies, and innovative care.

May convene or lead interdisciplinary task forces to address issues related to nursing practices, especially as it pertains to the care of the cardiovascular patient. Advises nursing leadership and providers on topics related to quality outcomes, evidence-based practice, and efficiency of clinical care. Leads, trains, and mentors nursing staff in one or more specialty areas.
Provides counsel and guidance on highly-complex issues of functionality, clinical quality, efficiency, and program development.
Evidence of training in health equity, diversity, and inclusion.
Expert knowledge of methodology for conducting evidence-based research, data collection, analysis, and reporting.
Expert critical thinking and problem-solving skills to assess highly-complex issues and develop multiple options for resolution.
Expert skills in written and verbal communications, with the ability to convey highly complex and / or sensitive information in a clear and concise manner.

Expert knowledge of one or more clinical specialty areas, and often broad knowledge of multiple specialties. Includes diagnoses, treatments, standards of practice, patient / family educational consulting, and resources.
Highly developed interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with management and staff across departments.
